neighbours.label: classical-mechanics force statements ('no external forces', 'unbalanced force')
fire: Momentum is conserved when there are no external forces acting on the system.
An object stays at rest unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.
Inside the closed system only internal forces do work on the particles.
If the net external force is zero, the center of mass moves at constant velocity.
Newton's first law says a body keeps moving unless an outside force acts on it.
With no friction acting on the puck, it slides across the ice forever.
When the forces on the block are balanced, its acceleration is zero.
In the absence of external torques, angular momentum is conserved.
quiet: Momentum in the campaign grew when there were new volunteers joining the team.
An object of great value was kept in the museum's locked room.
Inside the closed office only senior staff do work on the contracts.
If the net income is zero, the company cannot pay its dividend.
Newton's biography says he kept working late into the night on his notes.
With no snow on the ground, the kids played soccer all afternoon.
When the accounts on the ledger are balanced, the books are closed.
In the absence of the manager, the assistant handled the meeting.

notes: Top example: 'no' in 'no external forces'; others: internal forces, unbalanced force. Output promotes ' external', ' conservative', ' constraint'.
